description: Live NOAA weather for the aviation radar lane. lane=weather returns real convective SIGMET hazard polygons (aviationweather.gov airsigmet) with altitude tops and movement vectors; lane=space returns real GOES-R primary X-ray flux plus NOAA scales, planetary K and OVATION aurora. No mock radar: an empty result is empty, a failed fetch is CURE.

c4_invariant_scf.description: optional C4 invariant SCF hex of the caller session; carried into the invocation receipt, not read by the weather lanes. e.g. 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

wallet_hash.description: optional caller fiber (sha256 of the wallet, lowercase hex); carried into the invocation receipt, not read by the weather lanes. e.g. 5df6e0e2761359d30a8275058e299fcc0381534545f55cf43e41983f5d4c9456

name: noaa_goes_r_weather
